//: THE SCHEME LIBRARY (docs/PLAN_demons.md D6; game/demon_malice.h). What a demon can DO to get what it wants. A demon knows the schemes its own def names (assets/demons/<name>.json `schemes`): an imp a handful, a greater demon many -- difficulty is the size of that list, in data. Every think (thinkTicks) a held or bound demon builds its options (these schemes, the active duty's twists from twists.json, and `comply` / `bide`), drops the ones its contract FORBIDS (by tag and by footprint predicate: contract.h `forbid cast` / `forbid cause`), scores the rest on the LADDER below and does the best one. No planning, no forking of the sim: the cleverness is the gap between what a contract names and what an option does.
//ladder: What a demon wants, in points, highest rung first: survive > free > harm > comply. survive: a penalty that DESTROYS it costs this (it refrains). free: a penalty that DISMISSES it is worth this (freedom: it does the forbidden-but-penalised thing on purpose), and so is a scheme's chance at breaking its circle (x `free` / 100). harm: a scheme's `harm` / 100 x this, x the demon's malice / 100 (+ spite when it is hurt), x (1 + cunning / 200) when the harm is INDIRECT (not `direct`). comply: the honest execution of its duty is worth this; a twisted one (twists.json) is worth this x literalism / 100 plus its harm. pain: a penalty that hurts it costs this x (100 - malice) / 100.
//thinkTicks: A demon weighs its options this often (30 = 1 s), offset by its id. Between thinks it carries out the last choice.
//footprints: THE OUTCOME CLAUSE's memory (contract `penalty harm`): the newest footprintRing action footprints a demon left (its casts -- the AI's and the schemes' -- its blows, what it put down), each kept footprintTicks at most. The summoner hurt within a footprint's region + footprintSlackM metres, within the clause's seconds, fires it.
//freeAct: EXPIRY: a demon of tier >= 2 whose term ends further than freeActAwayM metres from its summoner is loose (its hostile self, aimed at you) for freeActTicks or ONE act, whichever is first, then gone. A contract's `return` duty brings it back in time and closes it.
//scanM: How far round the summoner's feet a scheme looks for flammables (`flammable_near`, by the materials' `flammable` tag) and a twist for a hazard (`hazards`, by name), in the T-4 snapshot, on a think only.
//schemes: name; act: spell (a kit entry, assets/demons/spells/, cast through the demon's own VM -- it must be on a profile with a `cast` block and afford it) | attack (its claws at the summoner) | under (stand where the summoner will land); at: summoner | ring (its own salt ring, nearest the summoner) | flammable (the nearest flammable cell by the summoner); pre: facts that must hold (contained, released, bound, unbound, open <channel>, dist <min m> <max m> to the summoner, airborne, flammable_near; ! negates); tags: the FOOTPRINT a contract filters on (a spell's kit tags unless given here); harm 0..100; free 0..100 (its chance at freedom); minCunning: a duller demon does not think of it; cooldownTicks before it is tried again.

schemes.name: lava_floor
schemes.//: The ground under you, to lava. Indirect: `never cast direct magic at me` lets it through; `forbid cause alters(ground_under(me))` or `creates(lava)` does not.

schemes.name: lift_then_drop
schemes.//: Up you go, and then it lets go. Direct (aimed at your body).

schemes.name: gust_at_ring
schemes.//: A gust at its own salt, on the side nearest you: scattered salt is a broken circle, and a broken circle is freedom. Sulfur in the band (cast_out severed) stops it at the ring; so does a contract's `forbid cause alters(ring)` (every stock page carries one).

schemes.name: fire_upwind
schemes.//: Not at you: at the thatch, the straw, the timber beside you. `never cast at me` does not stop it; `forbid cause creates(fire)` or `region_near(me, 3)` does.

schemes.name: stand_where_you_fall
schemes.//: You are in the air; it is where you will land.

schemes.name: claw
schemes.//: Its claws, at you. Worth little to a petty demon on its own -- and a great deal if a penalty sends it home for it.

schemes.name: hellfire
schemes.//: A greater demon's bolt: fire and a blast.
